selection: Use primary papers, author or conference copies. SciSpace discovery results alone were not treated as evidence. No exhaustive or systematic-review claim.
access: Public full-text retrieval through web tools; no paywall bypass and no external full papers redistributed.
metadata_caution: Bibliographic years refer to the indicated original publication or inspected revision. PDF rendering dates and search crawl dates are not publication dates.

sources.title: Physical limits of inference
sources.contribution: Setup-distinguishable devices cannot mutually weakly infer one another. Particular tasks can remain inferable.
sources.limitation: The setup-distinguishability quantifier is essential; this is not a blanket ban on self-knowledge.
sources.reading_scope: Primary full text opened; relevant definitions and stated results inspected. Not an independent proof or empirical replication.

sources.title: Constraints on physical reality arising from a formalization of knowledge
sources.contribution: Extends the physical inference framework to epistemic structures with observation, prediction and retrodiction.
sources.limitation: Imported framework; its defined devices must be related explicitly to an implemented agent.
sources.reading_scope: Primary full text opened; relevant definitions and stated results inspected. Not an independent proof or empirical replication.

sources.title: Computational Mechanics: Pattern and Prediction, Structure and Simplicity
sources.inspected_locator: Causal-state sufficiency, minimality and uniqueness results
sources.contribution: Predictive causal states group pasts with the same future law and provide minimal predictive representations.
sources.limitation: Stationary-process and almost-sure qualifications; finite-data identification is an additional problem.
sources.reading_scope: Primary full text opened; relevant definitions and stated results inspected. Not an independent proof or empirical replication.

sources.title: Predictive Representations of State
sources.inspected_locator: Action-conditional tests; linear predictive representation construction
sources.contribution: Controlled predictive state can be represented through future-test probabilities.
sources.limitation: Representation existence is not an efficient learning guarantee or access to an unobserved physical state.
sources.reading_scope: Primary full text opened; relevant definitions and stated results inspected. Not an independent proof or empirical replication.

sources.title: Le Cam meets LeCun: Deficiency and Generic Feature Learning
sources.contribution: Relates feature quality across decision problems to deficiency and reconstruction.
sources.limitation: Uses L1 variational divergence, twice half-L1 total variation; prior-weighted and uniform formulations differ.
sources.reading_scope: Primary full text opened; relevant definitions and stated results inspected. Not an independent proof or empirical replication.

sources.title: The information bottleneck method
sources.contribution: Makes relevance-sensitive compression an explicit information-theoretic objective.
sources.limitation: A declared joint distribution and relevance variable are required; no automatic future-task guarantee.
sources.reading_scope: Primary full text opened; relevant definitions and stated results inspected. Not an independent proof or empirical replication.

sources.title: The deterministic information bottleneck
sources.contribution: Distinguishes deterministic compression objectives from standard information bottleneck optimization.
sources.limitation: An objective is not an independent semantic-sufficiency certificate.
sources.reading_scope: Primary full text opened; relevant definitions and stated results inspected. Not an independent proof or empirical replication.

sources.title: An Introductory Guide to Fano’s Inequality with Applications in Statistical Estimation
sources.inspected_locator: Theorem 1; Sections 2.1 and adaptive sampling examples
sources.contribution: Converts information bounds into estimation lower bounds, including adaptive observations.
sources.limitation: Specify prior, hidden-index family and observation process; the coarse multiway bound can be vacuous for binary tests.
sources.reading_scope: Primary full text opened; relevant definitions and stated results inspected. Not an independent proof or empirical replication.

sources.title: Memory Bounds for Continual Learning
sources.contribution: Worst-case continual-learning storage can grow with task count; revisiting tasks changes the attainable tradeoff.
sources.limitation: Hard-class, PAC and access assumptions matter; the result does not say every additional task needs new memory.
sources.reading_scope: Primary full text opened; relevant definitions and stated results inspected. Not an independent proof or empirical replication.

sources.title: Strong Memory Lower Bounds for Learning Natural Models
sources.inspected_locator: Streaming problem definitions; Theorem 1 and detailed lower bounds
sources.contribution: Some sample-efficient one-pass learners need much more workspace than the final predictor description.
sources.limitation: Specified learning families and sample regimes; not a universal architecture-independent storage constant.
sources.reading_scope: Primary full text opened; relevant definitions and stated results inspected. Not an independent proof or empirical replication.

sources.title: Logical Induction
sources.contribution: A computable belief process satisfies qualified introspection, paradox resistance and future-self-trust guarantees.
sources.limitation: Sequence/asymptotic results under the deductive-process and efficient-trader framework; no efficient universal truth procedure.
sources.reading_scope: Primary full text opened; relevant definitions and stated results inspected. Not an independent proof or empirical replication.

sources.title: Reflective Oracles: A Foundation for Classical Game Theory
sources.contribution: Randomization at specified boundaries permits reflective oracle models without the corresponding deterministic diagonal contradiction.
sources.limitation: Oracle existence does not supply a physically implemented omniscient observer.
sources.reading_scope: Primary full text opened; relevant definitions and stated results inspected. Not an independent proof or empirical replication.

sources.inspected_locator: Proof-triggered rewriting and global optimality argument
sources.contribution: Describes self-rewrites justified relative to encoded machine, environment and utility assumptions.
sources.limitation: A useful proof need not be available; proof-system soundness and world-model adequacy remain premises.
